summary: A revision card's presentation names what the candidate mission revision adds, removes and changes, step by step

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. Attention.presentation gains an optional revision object (AttentionRevision in client-v0.schema.json); the generated clients gain its types.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Additive and optional under the presentation capability, version 1: present only on revision-approval rows whose proposal and both revisions st still has. Clients that do not read it are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. The attention refresher reads each revision-approval row's proposal, its run's generation and both published revisions when it presents the row: a few indexed reads per open revision approval.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
